description: Send a plain-text email from the connected account. Optional 'attachments' is a list of blob ids (from blob storage) that are attached by filename + mime type. Returns the sent message id and thread id. Requires a connected account. This is a write action — it delivers real mail.
embedding_description: Compose and send an outgoing email through the connected Gmail account: a recipient address, a subject, a plain-text body, and optionally files pulled from platform blob storage to attach. Builds the MIME message and hands it to Gmail for delivery. Returns the sent message id. The outbound mail verb.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with the sent message id and thread id.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the message was delivered to the recipient and give the message id. Because this delivers real mail, be explicit that it was sent.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Send an email from the connected Gmail account.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing 'to' or an unresolvable attachment blob id. gsuite.permission_denied: the granted scope does not allow sending. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a 'to' address and valid attachment blob ids. gsuite.permission_denied: re-run connect_account so gmail.modify is granted. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
